philosophy.title: Central Control Plane in Your Environment
philosophy.description: Swarm Agentic Lab is not a traditional SaaS platform. Our mission is to help organizations replace fragmented SaaS workflows with autonomous agent systems that run within their own environment.

data_residency: No training on customer data without explicit agreement
SAML SSO and OIDC integrations available based on deployment requirements

compliance.description: Compliance requirements vary by customer environment and deployment architecture. Because Swarm is designed to operate within customer-controlled infrastructure, security, governance, and compliance controls can align with your organization's existing requirements and policies. All agents developed will undergo all compliance standards across the globe and pass it eventually. Furthermore, you can build your own custom compliance agents for your organization to enforce internal standards.
